Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1627 of 2023
Applicant :- Pawan Kumar

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Deptt. Sectt. Lko And Another

Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Sri Vijay Kumar Tiwari, Advocate has put in appearance for the applicant by filing his
vakalatnama, which is taken on record.
2. Heard Sri Pankaj Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Jaiprakash, learned Addl.
Government Advocate, Sri Vijay Kumar Tiwari, Advocate for the informant, and perused the record.
3. By means of the instant application the applicant Pawan Kumar seeks bail in Case Crime No. 53 of 2023, under sections 376, 323, 504, 366, I.P.C., P.S. Sadulla Nagar, District Lucknow.

4. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged by the victim/informant on 14.04.2023 against the applicant, his father and sister stating that the informant had got married to the applicant on 10.02.2023 as per Hindu rites and rituals.
Later on, she came to know that the applicant was already married and he has a daughter, aged about 11 years.

sentences.text: her parents had given dowry in the married, but the accused persons used to harass her for demand of additional dowry.

5. In the statement of the informant recorded under section 161, Cr.P.C. she stated that her marriage was solemnized in a Dharmshala in Ludhiyana, and that the applicant has married her concealing the fact of his earlier marriage.
Similar statements were given by the mother and father of the informant.
6. In the additional statement of the victim, she stated that no invitation-cards were printed in her wedding ceremony and no photographs or videographs were prepared.
She further stated that the CCTV Footage of cameras installed at the wedding place are maintained for 10 days and the same are also not available now.
She further stated that no register is maintained in the temple, where her marriage was solemnized.
7. Learned counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the bail-application, submitting that as per section 90, Indian Penal Code reads as under- 90.

8. Earlier the applicant had filed a Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 4786 of 2023, which was disposed of by an order dated 22.06.2023 directing the Police to follow the mandate of section 41-A,
Cr.P.C.

In the affidavit filed in support of the bail-application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

In para-37 of the affidavit the applicant's involvement in one case bearing Case Crime No. 0037 of 2022 under sections 419, 420,
467, 468, 471, 323, 392, I.P.C., P.S. Saidulla Nagar, District Balrampur, has been disclosed, in which case after investigation Police has submitted a final report.

11. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the shifting stands taken by the informant regarding the factum of her marriage with the applicant,
